title: A locally finite measure carried by an n-dimensional subspace V and invariant under translations by V is a constant multiple of Hⁿ⌞V
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim V = n (Module.finrank ℝ V = n), and let m be a Borel measure on ℝ^P such that m(ℝ^P ∖ V) = 0, m(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, and m({x : v + x ∈ A}) = m(A) for every v ∈ V and every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P. Then there is c ∈ [0, ∞] with m = c·(Hⁿ⌞V), i.e. m(A) = c·Hⁿ(A ∩ V) for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P, where Hⁿ = μHE[n] is Mathlib's Euclidean-normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (m : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → m (V : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → m K < ∞) → (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → m ((fun x => v + x) ⁻¹' A) = m A) → ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, m = c • (μHE[n]).restrict (V : Set (Euclid P))
